description: Hiring radar, SalesJobs.Now's record of the sales job market for investors and analysts: every sales role read from the hiring companies' own careers systems since the board began, one row each with its posted pay, kind of sales work, countries and the days it opened and closed, plus every company day by day and a log of changes. Returns today's coverage, the files, who buys it, the price and how to ask for a sample. Use it only when someone wants to buy or evaluate the full historical dataset. For today's counts use get_sales_market, and for single roles use search_sales_jobs.
name: get_hiring_radar
title: Sales hiring data for investors
